integration_gap.what_would_catch_it: An integration test that: (1) mounts InstanceDetailPage with a mocked instance that lacks definition_name/definition_version, (2) mocks useDefinition to return null/undefined to simulate a loading state, (3) opens the cancel dialog via a button click, (4) asserts the dialog does not contain 'undefined'. Such a test would fail against the mutant (TC-ISS0809-02's not.toContain('undefined') assertion) and pass against the fix.
integration_gap.tc_iss0809_02_behavior: TC-ISS0809-02 asserts `screen.queryByText(/undefined/).not.toBeInTheDocument()` on a dialog rendered with instanceName='—'. Against the mutant (which produces 'undefined v undefined' in InstanceDetailPage), TC-ISS0809-02 would FAIL if the test went through InstanceDetailPage. Because it doesn't, TC-ISS0809-02 only validates that CancelInstanceDialog itself doesn't inject 'undefined' when given a placeholder '—' — which is a weaker but still valid safety check.
